//: code-intel tool plans for orders_app.golden.json, read by scripts/workflow-bench.ts. The golden holds the questions, facts and edges and is not edited; this file holds only what is specific to code-intel: how the fixture is split into services, and each question's codegraph_* plan remapped to the closest of code-intel's four MCP tools. `from` records the original step. A step with no code-intel equivalent is listed under `unmapped` with the reason, never silently dropped.
//symbols: code-intel seeds a query by function name, verbatim SCIP symbol or file path, not by file:line. Each target line is translated to the name defined there. Where that name is ambiguous in the store (__init__ matches 14 symbols), the step passes the verbatim SCIP symbol instead: it is the unambiguous locator code-intel accepts, as its own ambiguity answer instructs, and it is stable because runScipPython fixes --project-name to the service and --project-version to 0.0.0.
//services: api declares include [] rather than ["app/**"]: api/ holds only app/ and a Dockerfile, so the file set is the same, but a single directory include makes runScipPython pass --target-only, scip-python then reports document paths relative to app/ (config.py, not app/config.py), and the app/** gate drops every document -- 0 symbols. web has no package.json in the fixture; the bench writes one named after the service into its temp copy, because scip-typescript otherwise names the package after whatever package.json encloses the temp dir and code-intel drops every symbol as non-local.
